raw.buffDescription: After a period of time from the start of the fight, become Enraged and gain additional Attack Damage, Ability Accuracy, Critical Rate, and Critical Damage. If Enrage continues, become further Enraged and gain additional effects. Opponents with greater Attack increase the amount of time before becoming Enraged.
